requirements: The reviewed fixed Hero component of the P10 certification chain, as a brief: a hero section for a landing page with a title, a subtitle, a left or center alignment and one call-to-action button that counts its clicks in a data-clicks attribute. Editable fields: title (text), subtitle (textarea), align (radio: left, center), ctaLabel (text). One stylesheet, one decorative mark resource, no remote resources, no dependencies beyond react and @puckeditor/core.
